title: Quick Crisp Malaysian Cornmeal Bowl
description: A garlicky and crisp Malaysian dish featuring white masarepa, served in a stone bowl, perfect for a nostalgic meal. This dish is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
In a large bowl, mix together the white masarepa, water, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked garlic and oil mixture to the bowl and stir until combined.
Heat a stone bowl over medium heat and add a small amount of sesame oil.
Add the masarepa mixture to the stone bowl and cook until the bottom is crispy and golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Loosen the edges of the cornmeal with a spatula and flip it over to cook the other side.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also crispy and golden brown.
Remove from heat and top with chopped scallions and a drizzle of soy sauce.
